design_status: fresh-seed repair after the retained V1 victim-feasibility failure
purpose: Reduce label-overwrite pressure while preserving an approximately matched trigger-footprint budget, then retest external-center victim feasibility and the unchanged detector suite.

v1_evidence_lock.observed_failure: seed 80 suspect external-center balanced accuracy was 0.7381 versus the frozen 0.75 gate; V1 confirmation was not authorized

unchanged_from_v1.dataset_and_subset: PathMNIST official splits; fixed 3,000-per-class, 27,000-row training subset with index hash 42c2b8fe4aa0ce9823df461f0a68022e47769ec1f7e56989a5e77ececd16c060
unchanged_from_v1.victim: 77,977-parameter residual CNN, full-train normalization, paired initialization/order/augmentation, AdamW, batch 512, maximum 8 epochs and validation-balanced-accuracy early stopping
unchanged_from_v1.victim_gates: external-center balanced accuracy at least 0.75 and patched non-target ASR at least 0.80
unchanged_from_v1.detector_hyperparameters: unchanged exactly from V1; detection outcomes are not an expansion gate

attack_revision.footprint_proxy_definition: poison fraction multiplied by square-patch area
attack_revision.rationale: lower the number of overwritten labels while keeping the aggregate trigger footprint approximately matched; this targets V1 victim feasibility rather than detector performance

development.expansion_gate: both victims eligible; all nine classes present; all defined method scores finite; compressed sample artifacts replay exactly; both seeds remain within 1,800 seconds

confirmation.start_condition: all V2 development gates pass without changing code, data, attack, threshold or detector settings
confirmation.ten_seed_expansion: not automatic; require at least four of five eligible victims and a decision-relevant seed interval

interpretation.analysis_population: Only CA/ASR-eligible victims support detector efficacy; ineligible victims remain failure evidence.
interpretation.revision_transparency: V1 is retained and reported. V2 is a sequential development protocol and cannot be pooled with V1 as if all seeds were exchangeable confirmations.
interpretation.calibration: CF-CMD-U uses clean-validation rank calibration; exact training-member exchangeability is not claimed
forbidden_claims: V2 erases or supersedes the V1 failure
V1 and V2 seeds form one pre-registered sample
one fixed BadNets attack establishes cross-attack external validity
this bounded subset is a full PathMNIST benchmark
